title: Git Histories Diverged After Filter-branch
content: After successful filter-branch cleanup and force push, git pull now fails with 'refusing to merge unrelated histories'. The filter-branch operation completely rewrote git history, making local and remote incompatible. Need to choose resolution strategy.
resolution_options: git reset --hard origin/main (accept remote, lose local changes)
git push --force origin main (overwrite remote with local)
